batting.dismissal: c KH Pandya b Mohsin Khan

batting.dismissal: c Rashid Khan b MM Sharma

batting.name: DJ Hooda
batting.dismissal: c R Tewatia b Mohammed Shami

batting.name: MP Stoinis
batting.dismissal: c Mohammed Shami b MM Sharma

batting.name: N Pooran
batting.dismissal: c Mohammed Shami b Noor Ahmad

batting.name: A Badoni
batting.dismissal: c Noor Ahmad b MM Sharma

batting.name: KH Pandya
batting.dismissal: c DA Miller b MM Sharma

balls.text: Yorker on leg stump at 137kph is flicked to long-on for a single.

Bouncer pulled, Pooran dives and tumbles but can't stop it. Was a slower ball angling in, Miller stayed leg side and hit it into the ground. Pooran ran to the left from deep-mid, tried to leap and push the ball back in but couldn't
Pulls a shortish ball outside off to long-on. He'll move to 94* with two balls left and loses strike
Into the pitch outside off, Gill chops hard but doesn't time it. Hits the pitch and goes back to the bowler, who turns around to ensure they don't take a single
Slaps the wide yorker in the gap at cover, calls for two early. Deep cover runs to the left and the batters make it easily
Slot ball and Gill pumps it straight for an 86-metre six. Gill was deep in the crease and that helped him convert a yorker into half-volley
Miller's too early on the swing and is beaten. Cutter at 124kph was on a length, pitched around fourth stump and angled away. Miller tried to swipe it over midwicket
Wide yorker, Miller carves it again. This time squarer, gets it in the gap behind point for an easy couple
Slot ball arrives and Miller whacks the 138kph ball over long-on. It's a clean swing, clubbed it. The max height was 23 metres, and it went close to one of the cameras
Pulls the short, slow ball to deep midwicket
Wide yorker at 140kph, Miller takes a step across while being deep in the crease. Carves it along the ground to deep point
Wide low full toss, whipped to deep midwicket
Close to a yorker outside off, Gill tries to thwack it through long-on. Gets it off the bottom of the bat and the ball goes along the ground
Slower length ball outside off, slapped into the grass to cover. Quick run taken
Full toss on middle and off, thumped flat and straight. Too straight for long-on, Miller has his first boundary and GT bring up 200
Bouncer just outside off, left alone. One bouncer for the over called

Slow, wide length ball. Gill tries to slash over point, gets an underedge into the pitch. Ball spins to the edge of the leg side of the pitch, bowler runs across but can't prevent the single. Finch, on air, observes that the bowlers have done well to pull their lengths back with the slower ones after Stoinis was punished when he went slow and full earlier
Low full toss on middle, flicked to deep midwicket
Back of length outside off, thick outside edge off the back-foot square drive takes it to deep third
Back of length slower ball is pulled to midwicket

Avesh goes wide of the crease Gill makes room, thumps a drive to the right of the bowler. Avesh stuck out his right hand and the ball made contact with the index and middle fingers. Thankfully, he's able to continue. It went very straight, so long-off did not have a chance
Pulled into the ground, long-on runs to the right. He can't stop the two, which Gill called early for.
Length ball at 132kph drifts down leg but Miller misses the glance, ball ricochets off the pad towards square leg
Gill was in the crease, so a potential slot ball came in like one off the length. The back leg was bent and Gill was a tad hurried as he pulled it to deep square leg

Pandya catches Pandya, stinger at cover. Well taken. Mohsin has his arms up, Hardik leaves with a smile, Krunal wrings his hands. Was a slower length ball at 122kph, Hardik set up well and slapped it powerfully but the timing was off.
Another free-swinging shot, this time a pull. Gets it to deep midwicket. That was a slower ball
Gill has his first four with a free-swinging heave. It was around a length, pushing full, and angling away to around eighth stump.
Hard length around off, Hardik swats it into the pitch. Ball goes to deep midwicket
Slaps a shortish ball outside off to long-off
Mayers drops a tough, low chance at backward point. Back of length ball just outside off was cut with fierce power, as Daren Ganga says, might have hit the wrist of Mayers and popped out
Full on the legs, flicked to deep fine leg
Hardik was ready for the wide line by going across, got a length ball close to the tramline and slapped it over cover

Outside edge goes wide of short third and Stoinis has hands on his head. That was wide on a length, Hardik stretched and flayed at it with all his might. It went fast despite being off the edge, and went in the gap
Slower bouncer outside off, Hardik tries to pull it into the ground. Does so but off the bottom-half of the horizontal bat, the slowness helps him get two
Fuller offcutter is driven to long-on
Gill slams the slower slot ball over wide long-on. It was a top-shelf step-hit from the batter who swung across the line, flicked it ala MS to bring up his sixth six
Tries it again but this one's a bit fuller and Hardik's front foot being outside leg didn't help find the reach. Toe ends the ball to short third, fizzled along the grounf
Goes across and creams the flat extra-cover drive to get an 86-metre six. Yash saw Hardik and went wide, fast and full but Hardik's reflexes and position were on point
Wide, slow and full. Gill reaches out to the 122kph ball despite it being outside the tramline, plays the horizontal cover drive along the ground to the fielder in the deep
Wide yorker, Gill goes across and jams the bat but can't make contact. Ball landed around the off-side tramline and is called wide
Hardik takes a step across and muscles an off-drive. The ball was outside off and the connection was decent, but it went along the turf and straight to long-off
Low full toss outside off, driven to deep cover. Looked like a cutter, pace was 136kph
Around the yorker length at leg, Hardik cleared his front leg and tried to mow it away. Got it off the bottom of the bat, ball rolls to long-on
Pulls a short ball around neck-height at 136kph to deep-forward square
Pulls a shortish ball to deep midwicket
Pulls a short ball to deep square leg along the ground

Did that spin back onto the stumps? Yes, but it slowed down enough for the bails to not come off. Pandya was walking down and tried the back-foot whip to the back-of-length ball. May have taken the underedge, hit his body and lost considerable pace due to landing down and the spin
Length ball zips in towards leg stump at 136kph, inside edge off the attempted on-drive hits pad and ricochets in front

Down the track, Saha tries the back-foot flick while on the move. Mankad, the sub fielder, runs to the left from deep square leg and took a good low catch to end a brilliant 81. There have been similar balls to which Saha has played the same shot, he placement wasn't too bad this time, but athletic fielding cost him
Gill ensures Krunal doesn't finish well, mows the length ball with a spring-like step down the track and clears long-on with ease
Saha makes room and Krunal goes full on middle, Saha tries to go inside out, gets an inside edge. Ball goes to long-on
Flicks a length ball at 98kph to long-on
Clips a length ball to long-on off the inside edge

Saha reaches out and manages to slice the full toss over short third. Ball was on the tramline, Saha's upper body had to bend while his feet were still, the bottom hand came off as he made contact. Did well to retain decent timing
Gill gets to fifty with a flick to midwicket. Raises his bat and gets a round of applause from the crowd and a handshake from his partner.
Full ball at 90kph on the pads is turned to deep-backward square. Swapnil helps LSG get back-to-back good overs
Cuts a shortish ball outside off to deep cover
Swapnil reacts well to Saha charging while making room, goes into the pitch and outside off. Slapped off the bottom of the bat into the pitch, back to the bowler
Yorker on off, punched to long-off
Full on middle, nudged to midwicket again. Early call of two, long-on runs across but they come back easily
Tight two attempted, deep midwicket runs in but can't pick it up. They make it easily. Was a length ball on leg at 88kph
Length on leg, clipped to long-on
Walks down the track as he drives after getting close to the pitch, to long-off
Length down leg, flicked to deep-backward square. Pace: 99kph
Saha tries to reach a wide full toss, outside the tramline, but toe-ends it, into the ground and then to long-off
Length on leg, punched to long-on off the back foot
Saha makes room and gets good bounce and width, slaps it in the air but lands in the outfield and goes to deep cover
Saha charges and Bishnoi sees him, bowls it wide on a length at 96kph. Saha's able to lunge across and he tried to push it towards cover. Ball hit pad and went towards backward point
Drives a full ball outside off to deep cover
Monster over the bowler's head, 96-metre six. Gill took a step in front, stayed leg side, got the ball around shin-height. It was just outside off and he pumped it straight
Wide googly comes back in a bit after landing past the off-side tramline but not enough to not be wide. GIll left it alone
Down the track, doesn't get to the pitch but Saha manufactures enough room to slap it off the lower-quarter of the bat. To deep point
Drives a length ball to deep cover
Slapped over extra to bring up GT's hundred. Nice stride in front taken by Gill, freed his arms and smashed it

Underedge hits the right thigh of QDK and goes fine for four. Length outside off, Saha tried to cut it but Mayers' angle from around the wicket and lack of bounce didn't allow Saha to find the middle of the bat. But he has a four nonetheless
Low, slow full toss outside off. Gill bends across and tries to swipe it across to the leg side. Bat hits the toe and fizzles to midwicket
High full toss is called a no-ball. Krunal has a chat with the ump, LSG can't review as they took too much time. Saha had not crouched much and it hit the sticker of the bat, well over waist-height.
Saha pierces the field this time. Mayers went into the pitch and Saha pulled it into the gap at wide long-on
Deep fine leg was brought in and Saha went for the paddle. He went across and missed it but the fullish ball turned away and hit the pad outside off-stump's line
Makes room, gets the back-of-length ball around waist-height with enough room, slaps it over backward point. Into the outfield, four more
Back of length into leg, pulled to deep midwicket
Short-arm jabs a ball around a back of length, on middle and off, to deep midwicket. Pace: 98kph. Great over from Bishnoi, he went flat and bowled stump to stump. Just four off the over
Length outside off, belted to deep cover
Full and flat on middle, flicked to deep-forward square
Bishnoi's keeping the trajectory flat. On off, punched with an open face to deep point
Down the track, gets close-ish to the pitch and defends to cover off the front foot
Looked like a googly. Came in off a length at 94kph, punched from fourth stump to cover

Helped over fine leg, given the full service in fact. Many rows back for a huge six. Ump taps the watch immediately after signalling six. The angle coming in brought the ball down leg and Gill stayed tall and swivelled, and belted it across
Yorker around off, clipped to long-on
Bunts a back-of-length ball to deep midwicket
Down the track, pulls it with limited timing. Finds deep midwicket along the ground
Tries the pull again but the back-of-length ball at 140kph hurries him, beats bat and hits him on the thigh pad and ricochets in front

Flat bats over long-off to get to a 20-ball fifty. It's only been five overs into the innings! Saha read the slower one perfectly, charged and heaved it flat and over the fence. He raised his bat and the dugout is in applause. Shiva Jayaraman says this is Saha's fastest fifty in the IPL. His previous fastest was off 22 balls against SRH in 2014, playing for Punjab

Hooda jumps back and tries to take a flying catch in front the long-off boundary but can't bring it in. He was mid-air, facing the fence and past the cushion as he caught the bowl, was in full-stretch mode as he tried to lob it back in but couldn't impart enough power to do so.

Gill misses the sweep, LBW appeal turned down. Krunal chats with QDK and reviews with 5 seconds to go. Fair ball. Did Gill get an edge? Doesn't look like it on the first slow-mo replay. Landed on a length on middle, came in and hit the top of the front pad's knee roll. Height may be the issue now. It is. Going over the stumps, review lost
Length on middle, stays leg side and punches to cover
Flicks a length ball on the back foot through cow corner, goes along the ground and the fielder has to run across, which allows two
Krunal stays around and bowls stump-to-stump darts. This one on a length at 96kph, Gill made room and tried the back-foot cover-drive. Outside edge goes to short third
Length on leg, clipped to midwicket
Saha's exhibition of playing the pull shot continues and it brings up GT's fifty in four overs. Back of length outside off, swivels across and whacks it into the outfield just in front of square

Inside out over extra cover again. Looked like a slower one, overpitched just outside off. Saha took a small step towards the line and launched it seamlessly. 'Sexy shot' says Daren Ganga on air, hard to disagree. 83-metre six, a Titans player at the dugout leapt up to try and catch it but it was too high
Saha goes across to turn the ball behind square, finds the gap at long leg. Got it on a length, braced his legs and rolled his wrist to direct the flick with precision
Length just outside off, stabby cut from Gill with little follow-through takes it to the left of deep point. Pace: 138kph
Overpitched, driven past the diving cover fielder but there's cover, pardon the pun, in the deep. Pace: 122kph
Saha drags a pull from outside off, deposits over forward square leg for an 81-metre six. Banged in on a shortish length but came at a pace with which Saha dealt with at ease
Flicks a length ball to Avesh at square leg

Misfield at mid-on allows the second, there's a dive at the non-striker's end. No direct hit, Krunal knocked over the stumps with his hands. Was a fullish ball at 103kph flicked to the right of the fielder
Length at the stumps, flicked to midwicket
Length ball is gently clipped behind square
Saha backs away and goes away from Krunal's angle from around the wicket, to go inside out over cover, despite the ball being on a good length
Clips a length ball to midwicket
Down the track, gets the short ball around chest-height and swivels again to pull the ball behind square. Lands in the outfield and finds the boundary
Saha swivels and rides the short ball fine, gets a 55-metre six. Wasn't a short ball, landed around a back of length but rose well, Saha did well too, to swivel and help it along the way
Saha's outside the crease, tries to make room and slash it square, over the off side. But the length ball at 138kph outside off zips past the bat
Back of length at the stumps, defended to backward point

Saha swivels on the pull, almost drags the ball onto off stump. Was a back-of-length ball on the thigh, didn't seem to come as quickly as Saha, who was a tad outside the crease, expected. It ricocheted and went past the line of the stumps, just a bit away
Slightly wide of the crease. Length ball comes in and is tapped gently towards midwicket. Quick single after an early call
Fullish ball just outside off, defended with an angled bat to point
Half-volley outside off, Saha stays still and creams it along the ground. Finds the gap between short extra cover and mid-off
Outside edge takes the ball to the deep-third boundary. Length outside off, played with soft hands but with a bit of tentativeness. Deep third puts in the dive but can't stop it

Saha flashes and misses but the length ball angles away sharply again and goes past the off-side tramline. The ball swung away and de Kock dove to the right, the ball hit low on his fingers and he's in some pain
Uppish push lands safely in the gap at cover, Krunal chases from mid-off to the outfield and stops it. The cutter gripped in the pitch and it meant Saha was on the shot too early.
Length at 130kph around off, pushed to cover
Angles away outside off and is left alone. The length ball, pushing full, at 136kph, pitched outside off and the angle on it was sharp.
Length outside off, defended to cover.
Bishnoi makes room again and tries to slap it over backward point. Gets beaten
Bishnoi was stepping down again and Joseph dug in with another hostile bumper. Bishnoi did well to lunge low and let it go. Mohit Sharma has a smile in the deep

Joseph's bowling hostile bumpers now, Bishnoi was ducking in reflex while backing away and fell over. The bat was still over his shoulder. He decides to review for a wide, third umpire says it wasn't too high.
Bishnoi was making room and taking a step forward. Joseph pushed him back with a bouncer angling in towards his body, he tried to upper cut it and missed it
Bishnoi slaps the length ball outside off at 141kph and with mid-off in, all he had to do was clear the infield, which he did with ease
Length on leg at 137kph, flicked to deep-backward square
Back-of-hand slower ball is full and wide, Krunal tries to slog it across but finds long-on. Went off the top edge. Mohit's thanking the heavens again
Slower one finds the top edge off the slog sweep, Noor settles under after taking a few steps across, takes it low to the left
Badoni steps across and Mohit goes even wider and concedes an extra after it's left alone
Offcutter into the pitch outside off is pulled over midwicket. Manohar runs across and slides but can't stop it

Rashid throws from backward point and misses. Swapnil comes halfway down and goes back to the non-striker's end. The throw was off and Mohit tried to slide across and take it, half-stopped it. The ball was a wide yorker that was sliced to the fielder
Another slower one on a similar line is swiped across, didn't look like Badoni got much on it but clears the straight boundary for an 84-metre six
Slower one bounces and fizzes off the deck. It's around seventh stump and beats Badoni's swing. The bottom hand comes off and the ball bounces to the keeper
Yorker on off, worked to long-on. It's now mathematically impossible for LSG to win unless there are extras and boundaries (sixes) every ball
Full on leg, swept to deep fine leg
Length ball pitches outside off and turns away to beat the sweep. That was a googly
Full on middle, driven back to the bowler
Pooran tries to slog sweep a legbreak outside off but the length ball turns away and balloons off a top edge to Shami at short third
Full outside off, swept to deep midwicket
Slower full ball outside off, Badoni made room and had to adjust his stroke. Ends up flicking gently towards midwicket
Yorker around off, Badoni makes room and carves it to the right of deep cover. They run fast and make a risky two
Slow ball on a fullish length at the pads, swept behind square. Fielder in the deep stops it
Tries the reverse pull but is beaten and gets hit on the body. Pooran calls for a leg-bye and Shami runs across but the batters make it through
Badoni goes across first ball and laps it ten rows back, over fine leg. It was a full ball outside off, he was away early and somehow nailed it
Low full toss on middle, driven to long-off

QDK goes across and might be bowled around his legs, Bharat appeals. Anil Chaudhary is unsure and sends it upstairs. Side-on replay shows there's a sound as the ball brushes the stumps. The bails come off and QDK has to go. He premeditated, tried to slog sweep the full ball but was beaten, almost covered the stumps while playing the shot
Full on middle, tossed up as much as Rashid Khan despite being 95kph, whacked to wide long-on
Looped up outside off, Pooran inside edges onto pad. He tried to slog sweep it but got it onto the back pad
Pulls a shortish ball from outside off to deep midwicket
Length over leg, worked across behind square leg and quick running allows two
Short outside off and QDK has ample time to pull it over midwicket

Edge off the slow, wide ball doesn't carry to the keeper. It was outside the tramline, Pooran slashed and got an edge off the horizontal-batted slash. Sunil Gavaskar says there should have been a signal between bowler and keeper

Pace off again, Stoinis aims for long-on and balloons it to short third. Full ball was outside off, Stoinis stayed just a bit away from leg stump, tried slogging it across but it went up, like it does against legspinners and Mohit thanked heavens after Shami took a dolly
Full and slow outside off again, driven to long-off
Slot ball, QDK stays still, waits and pumps it over long-off. It was a slower offcutter around sixth stump, Mohit closed his eyes and turned his head back in frustration in his follow-through
Yorker just outside off, dust puffs up as Stoinis whips it off the inside-half of the bat to wide long-on. Called for two but it wasn't on
Slow, full and wide. QDK is early on the lofted cover drive, bottom hand comes off and ball balloons over backward point. Fielder runs back and keeps it to one
QDK makes room and flat bats it hard but can get it with limited power to long-on
Length on leg, beats the flick, hits thigh pad and deflects towards backward square leg
Clearly bamboozled there, the goog beats the outside edge. Stoinis stood still and tried to bunt it with a horizontal bat but had no conviction trying it, checked his bat but was late
Length around off, punched to cover. Stoinis is taking a few balls to settle in
Makes room and is followed by a slow yorker. The 88kph ball is driven hard and low, Noor half-stops it in the follow-through. Mid-off keeps it to one
Full ball is driven to long-off. Stoinis tried powering it but it went off the bottom of the bat and along the ground
Back of length ball comes in, flicked to deep-backward square
Yorker around off, flicked to deep midwicket
Back of length outside off, square driven off the back foot to deep point
Full ball, driven to mid-off

Full toss is hit to deep midwicket, Tewatia runs in and takes the catch. Ball was at the stumps, Hooda wound up and tried to slam it across the line but got it off the sticker. Hooda closes his eyes and almost swings the bat across in frustration while leaving
Length outside off, top edges a pull to deep midwicket. Lands on the bounce. QDK's disappointed but raises his bat kinda half-heartedly after realising he got up to fifty
QDK tries to sweep with the spin, doesn't time it well. In the air but doesn't carry to deep midwicket. Rashid whacks his cap on his leg in frustration as he leaves
Full just down leg, QDK tries to slog it over midwicket. Misses, hits pad and lands in front
Full on leg, clipped to deep midwicket
Length outside off, swept to deep fine
Full down leg, swept to deep midwicket
Length on leg, clipped to deep-backward square
Slow length ball around seventh stump. Hooda was across and belted a back-foot slap. Long-off ran to the left and keeps it to two
Slow into the pitch on the thigh pad, pulled to deep-backward square
Low full toss just outside off, lofs a drive to the outfield, long-off comes in and stops it
Full and slow outside off, slapped to long-off
Length outside off, QDK goes across and tries to ramp it across on the move. Gets it to short third
Slow into the pitch, the wide ball is cut to deep-backward point
Hardik doesn't miss the yorker by much but QDK clears the front leg just a bit and drills a flat flick over midwicket for an 89-metre six
Flicks a length ball to square leg
High full toss is dragged across to deep-backward square with a pull. Looked to have been around top-of-thigh high
QDK makes room and is followed by a 139kph yorker on his boot. Replay shows he actually flicked it from the back his back foot to the front foot, which was sliding back on the right
Hooda's taking guard outside leg. Gets a back-of-length ball at 138kph around off, thick outside edge off the back-foot cover drive takes it to deep third

Quinton swivels almost 180 degrees as he tries to pull the slower one into the pitch behind square, gets a top edge/glove that balloons over short third. Goes deep into the outfield but they take just one
QDK's front leg rises like that of a ballerina as he swats the length ball from outside off to deep square
Length on off at 130kph, Hooda goes across and clips it softly to deep midwicket
Slow and fullish just outside off, dabs it with an angled bat to short third
Hits it down the ground

Rashid loses control while sliding but manages to take a specky! He came in from deep fine, running to his diagonal right, he was on course to taking it but the slide folded his knees. He, nonetheless, didn't stop going with the momentum, stretched out his hands, plucked it and ran jubilantly in celebrations. He ran 26 metres far, says Mark Howard on air. It was a slower bouncer just outside off that Mayers bunt-pulled and tried to hit it into the ground but got a top edge
Slow ball on a fullish length outside off, dabbed to short third
Reverse swept over backward point from leg stump. QDK was across on off but managed to get his shoulders across and swing with ease

Strays down leg, the length ball is left alone by QDK after shaping for the flick. Bharat flicks the bails and appeals for a stumping to see it's called wide. He gets Hardik to review it, Ultra-Edge shows the ball flicked the trousers and the review is successful
Punches a length ball on off to long-on. Mayers' front foot went to the right as he was on the move
Full ball is clipped to long-on
Full ball outside the off-side tramline. Left alone
Another full toss slips out. QDK's ready on one knee and reverses it between the 16-metre gap between short third and backward point
Full toss outside off, middle the cover drive but Hardik leaps across to stop it
Length outside off, guided to short third
Pulls the shortish ball to deep square leg

Rashid's convinced with his LBW appeal, umpire says not out. Hardik chats and reviews with three seconds to go. Mayers was on the back foot, standing in his crease, and the legbreak pitched around off and came in. Mayers tried to block the length ball and Ultra-Edge shows a small spike and Mayers survives. GT's fielders were happy after the ball was shown not to be pitching outside leg but as George Binoy pings, that edge was a surprise
Length on leg, nudged to deep midwicket
Mayers crouches and pulls a length ball at 93kph along the ground in the gap at deep-forward square
Reverse sweeps a full ball along the ground to short third
Overpitched, drilled to the bowler's right and Hardik has no chance this time as it races straight. Third-best powerplay score for LSG, says Murali Karthik on air
Googly turns in sharply to go under the attempted slog sweep
Length outside off, underedges a horizontal-bat drive to cover

Skier, the pull finds the empty acreage in the deep-midwicket pocket. Miller runs to the left, man running back wasn't close either and the former's dive isn't enough. Was a length ball on middle, Mayers swung himself 90 degrees and the ball hit the sticker area but luckily for him, fell in the gap
Yorker around fifth stump, Mayers tries launching it over cover but hits it off the bottom to cover point
Good stop to the left at mid-off by Hardik, the dive saves four. Full ball around off, Mayers stayed leg side and thumped an off drive
Goes across, swivels and pulls it in the gap behind square to take Rashid's first-over run-tally up to 14.
Pulls a shortish ball to deep midwicket
Mayers swerves, his feet are criss-cross as he pumps the full ball straight back over Rashid's head
Turns a full ball to deep midwicket
Rashid goes full again, gets flicked through the gap at midwicket. Pace: 94kph
Sweep beaten, the full ball hits the outside-half of the front pad and goes towards short fine. LBW appeal is stifled as it was pitching down leg. Hawk-Eye spots an inside edge as well
Mayers top-edges the pull while swivelling to take the bouncer at head-height over short third to bring up LSG's fifty
Full toss is further down leg, Mayers tries shoveling it fine and misses
Yorker down leg, Mayers shapes for the flick before going across and watching it go

Is that a drop? Rashid didn't seem to spot the ball in the glare behind. It went low and he squatted and tried taking it but it popped out. He was 29 metres far and to the right of the umpire. The ball was a low full toss outside off that Mayers spooned while opening the bat face, the ball hovered low and the umpire cam showed a good view of it. Rashid pointed to the stands, indicating the glare, later
Low full toss on middle. Mayers stays leg side and punches it off the front foot, well timed but finds mid-off
Length over top of middle at 141kph, QDK waits and defends it off the back foot with an open face to deep third
Low fully, QDK gets low and clips it wide of Joseph at mid-on. He ran to the left but it raced in the gap. Outfield's still fast
QDK pulls and stays still, doesn't bother running. Why would he? He crunched it, swivelled and got it way over the infield. Ball was shortish and just outside off.

Front-foot punch directs the yorker through the gap at cover. Cover point put in the dive to the left but couldn't stop it. Mayers had made room early and got the ball just to his left, he got on one knee and hit it firmly
Length on the pads, beats the flick, hits pad and falls in front
Swung away over midwicket, holds his shape and clears the boundary for an 82-metre six. Was on a fullish length and Mayers nailed it

Mix-up among the batters after QDK's halway down the pitch but the fielders- gully, point, cover - don't communicate either and they take an easy single. Was a length ball just outside off that was defended off the back foot with an open-faced bat

QDK goes across and swats a paddle behind square. The ball was on a length following him, the batter squared himself up intentionally to get an extra second and did well to flap it away. Shami has a smile

Creams the length ball outside behind point. Not much footwork from QDK either but he picked the length and the angle early, stayed still and chopped it into the pitch. Went high off the bounce and in the gap
Length on off, blocked towards cover
Stays leg side and blocks the length ball on off to cover. Mayers isn't moving his feet much. If he has, it's more to make room or go across early.
